～Chapter 2～
Stop the Runaway Engine!

Good, you’re all here.
Now to discuss what we’ve learned so far.
We are currently dealing with spiritual anomalies coming from the Mikasa.
In doing so, we’ve discovered the presence of demons inside.
What’s more, we’ve found civilians within that have no reason to be there.
Truly an unusual situation.

This is all so weird...
What would demons be doin’ there?
Furthermore, it’s odd we’d be finding civilians within the Mikasa.
All this and the spirit power anomalies... It’s just one oddity after another.
All these things happening around the Mikasa...
What could possibly be the cause of it all?
Ah! The Regalia!!
That’s right! We had to leave the Pandemonium Regalia behind with the Mikasa!
Ask about Regalia
Move on
I see, so the cause of all this must be the Regalia...
What on earth are you talking about?!
Something down there musta made the Regalia start acting up...
Causing ‘em to start emitting massive amounts of spirit power!
Now demons are poppin’ up in the Mikasa, drawn by that power.
So what about all the people?
All that excessive spirit power likely caused spatial rifts.
The townsfolk then went slipped through those rifts and into the Mikasa.
That’s gotta be how Tsubaki and the rest wound up there!
... This is too complicated, I don’t get it at all...
That’s only a theory, of course.
Reni’s right. We have no proof that the Regalia could’ve caused this.
But I don’t know if anything else could possibly fit the bill.
I can’t imagine anything besides the Regalia sould emit such power.
Meanin’ we oughta get back in the Mikasa and start lookin’ for ‘em.
Yes, that’s the plan.
Now to make it official.
<NAME>, you are hereby ordered to retrieve the Pandemonium Regalia.
However, as we now know, the Mikasa is occupied by demons and is thus highly dangerous.
You will have to bring a partner with you whenever you move out to investigate.
You can call on whoever is free at the moment to assist you.
Sound good?
Yes, ma’am!
Keep it together, <NAME>.
Y-Yes, ma’am! Roger!

You got this, .
You can leave fixing up the Koubu to me.
Yes, ma’am!

By the way, Kaede...
What’re we callin’ this mission, anyway?
The name of the mission, huh...
How’s about this?
Operation Thunderbolt
Operation Desert Tanuki
Operation Bearhug
How does “Operation Thunderbolt” sound?

Oooh!
That sounds awesome!
I love it!
It’s a good name, conveys strength.
I like it...
Agreed, I like the sound of it.
From now on, this mission will be called “Operation Thunderbolt”!
How does “Operation Desert Tanuki” sound?

“Tanuki”?
Well that sounds cute.

It’s very silly,
but also charming.
I like it.
I have no clue what it’s supposed to mean, but hey, it’s funny.
Yes, it’s certainly amusing, but...

It leaves something to desired.
What do you think, Kaede?
Indeed... This will be included in a report to the upper brass, so...
Well then, how’s about “Operation Thunderbolt”?
Oh, that sounds good.
From now on, this mission will be called “Operation Thunderbolt”!
How does “Operation Bearhug” sound?

Bears? I love bears!
I think it’s great.
It does sound rather... cool, doesn’t it?
It’s just a mission name, so it doesn’t necessarily have to mean anything.
If <NAME> thinks it’s a good name, then it’s fine by me.
Hmm... I suppose, but...

C’mon, I thought you had an idea or somethin’.
Oh, fine, I’ll pick one, then.
How we feel about “Operation Thunderbolt”?
Oh, that sounds good.
From now on, this mission will be called “Operation Thunderbolt”!

,
commence Operation Thunderbolt!!
I’m sorry, what exactly is the “Pandemonium Regalia”?
The Regalia are mystical implements, safeguarded in the Imperial Capital since long ago.
The Regalia consist of three items: the sword, the jewel and the mirror.
Their power is immense, whether they be used for good or evil.
They are extremely dangerous in the wrong hands.
One year ago, they were wielded by a man who attempted to bring the entire world to ruin.
He was finally defeated thanks to the efforts of the Flower Division,
but unfortunately, the Regalia followed him to the bottom of the sea...
The Mikasa Memorial Park was established atop the very site of that battle.

Do you understand now?
In that case, let’s move on.
